# Development Phase Template

> Guidance: copy to `docs/phases/PHASE-NNN-short-title.md`. Replace metadata, preserve `PHASE-NNN`, and add the record to `docs/phases/README.md`.

<!-- Allowed status: Draft, Proposed, In Review, Accepted, Completed, Superseded, Archived -->

## Objective

State the intended outcome without claiming it is achieved.

## Scope

- In-scope work
- Explicit exclusions

## Deliverables

- Link implementation and documentation deliverables.

## Requirements Addressed

- PRD requirement IDs

## Dependencies

- Technical, environment, owner, or approval dependencies

## Tasks

- [ ] Task with evidence link when complete

## Risks

- Risk, impact, and mitigation

## Acceptance Criteria

- Objective, measurable criteria

## Evidence Required

- Test, workflow, configuration, or owner evidence

## Completion Summary

Use `Retrospective validation required` when implementation exists but formal evidence is unavailable.

## Follow-up Work

- Action, owner, due date, status
